explanation: Matzri (TAMS 2016) Theorem 8.2: for a C_m field F and n = p^t, every α ∈ K_2^M(F)/n is a sum of at most t(p^{m−1} − 1) symbols. I checked this against the arXiv text; no root-of-unity hypothesis is needed. ℂ(x_1..x_m) is C_m by Tsen–Lang, and m ≥ 1 is assumed. The statement is correct and solved.
